What changed since the last brief (10:20 pm): NWS advisories were extended: Coastal Flood Advisory to Fri 4 pm and again to Sat 6 pm, Beach Hazards Statement to Fri 6 pm, High Surf Warning to Sun 4 am. What's on (each confirmed on an official page)

1) Marc Seales with Ernie Watts: Thu Nov 12, 7:00 and 9:15 pm. Black Cat, SF. Tickets $20–$50 including fees. https://tickets.blackcatsf.com/shows/13307/2026-11-12

2) Stanley Clarke and Ron Carter: Thu Nov 12 and Fri Nov 13, 7:30 pm. SFJAZZ Center, Miner Auditorium, 201 Franklin St. $75–$175, listed "almost sold out". https://www.sfjazz.org/tickets/productions/26-27/stanley-clarke-and-ron-carter/

3) John Proctor Is the Villain: first preview Thu Nov 12, 7:30 pm (runs to Dec 13). A.C.T., Toni Rembe Theater, 415 Geary St. First 300 arrivals get a tote bag; about 1 hr 45 min, no intermission; ticket price not read. https://www.act-sf.org/whats-on/2026-27-season/john-proctor-is-the-villain

4) SF Symphony, Prokofiev Romeo and Juliet: Fri Nov 13, 7:30 pm. Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave. Free pre-concert talk one hour before for ticketholders; price not read. https://www.sfsymphony.org/Buy-Tickets/2026-27/Romeo-and-Juliet

5) Holly Bowling (Grateful Dead and Phish on solo piano): Fri Nov 13, 7:00 and 8:30 pm. SFJAZZ Joe Henderson Lab. $39, listed "almost sold out". https://www.sfjazz.org/tickets/productions/26-27/holly-bowling/

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, checked ~6:20 am Thu PT): Overnight mostly cloudy, 55 · Thu partly sunny, 70 · Thu night slight chance of light rain, 57 · Fri showers and thunderstorms, 64 · Fri night light rain likely, 54 · Sat chance of light rain then partly sunny, 65 · Sat night chance of light rain, 54.
Active advisories: Coastal Flood Advisory (ends Fri 4 pm; a second one ends Sat 6 pm), Beach Hazards Statement (Fri 6 pm), High Surf Warning (Sun 4 am).
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194 and https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194

Road closures

  • SB US-101 Hospital Curve weekend closure was scheduled to end Mon 6 am; reopening not re-read this run. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-us101-sb-bayshore-freeway-weekend-closure
  • Eastbound I-80 Bay Bridge, Rincon Hill to the YBI tunnel: one lane open Sun–Thu 10 pm–7 am most nights through mid-December (Sun, Mon, Tue nights affected). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-i80-sfobb-lane-closures
  • US-101 Marin (San Rafael area) nightly lane and ramp closures Mon Nov 9 and Thu Nov 12 – Sat Nov 14 morning, 10 pm–6 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-06-us101-capm
  • SR-82 El Camino Real, Burlingame: full closures, both directions. Rosedale Ave to Carmelita Ave Mon Nov 9 (and Wed–Fri) 9 am–6 pm; Carmelita Ave to Howard Ave Tue Nov 10, 7 am–6 pm. Detour via California Drive; SamTrans buses detour. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-06-ecr-closures
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo: daytime paving Mon–Thu 9 am–6 pm. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-sr29-lane-closure
  • Mill Valley: NB US-101 to NB SR-1 connector ramp closes when high tides flood it (late-morning highs Sun–Tue). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-03-us101-sr1-connector
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Rotated this run; descriptions from Michelin Guide indexed text and the restaurants' own sites.

Zuni Café, Hayes Valley / Civic Center, SF (1658 Market St). Own site: menus change daily, drawing on French, Italian and Mediterranean cooking with seasonal, organic ingredients; classics include house-cured anchovies, the Zuni Caesar and roast chicken for two. James Beard "Outstanding Restaurant" (2003). Dinner Tue–Sun 5–9:30 pm, lunch Fri–Sun 11 am–3 pm, closed Monday. Walkable to Davies for Friday's concert. (415) 552-2522. https://zunicafe.com/

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (55 Cyril Magnin St, in Parc 55). Michelin Guide One Star, Thai/Californian: Chef Pim Techamuanvivit's layered, produce-driven Thai cooking, such as hor mok curry mousse and a green curry with slow-cooked local rabbit; some dishes are very spicy. Own site hours: lunch daily 11:30 am–2 pm; dinner Sun–Thu 5:30–9 pm. (415) 362-7456. https://www.kinkhao.com/ · https://guide.michelin.com/ie/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/kin-khao

Tadich Grill, Financial District, SF (240 California St). Own site: California's oldest continuously run restaurant (since 1849), known for mesquite-grilled seafood, casseroles and stews, and classic cocktails; reservations taken, walk-ins welcome, counter seats for one or two. Mon–Fri 11 am–9 pm, Sat 4–9 pm, closed Sunday. (415) 391-1849. https://www.tadichgrill.com/

Getting around

Muni and cable cars: $2.85 single ride with Clipper or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 min. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports $15 / $35 / $47 (1/3/7-day). Youth 18 and under ride free (not cable cars). https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares

BART (live check ~6:19 am Thu):

  • 20-minute delay on the SF line toward Antioch/Berryessa/Dublin after an earlier track equipment problem between Colma and Daly City (recovering).
  • Expect 30-minute delays from 9 pm on some Sun–Thu nights between Millbrae and SFO (train control work).
  • Yellow Line late-night single tracking in Contra Costa Nov 12–13.
  • Night of Nov 14: reduced service, about 9-minute average waits for BART to OAK (planned maintenance).
  • Weekend Nov 14–15: free buses replace trains between 24th St Mission and Daly City.
  • Transbay Tube single-track lighting work next on Nov 21.
  • Elevator outages not itemized this run.
    https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories

Bikes and scooters: Lyft Bike / Bay Wheels: $1 to unlock + $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike; day pass $15. Lime and Spin pricing not rechecked. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels/pricing

SFO: Rental Car Center via AirTrain Blue Line (24 hours). Lyft/Uber/Wingz on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage; taxis at Arrivals center islands. https://www.flysfo.com/passengers/ground-transportation

Where to stay

Civic Center/Hayes Valley puts you near Davies, Head West, and Zuni. Union Square has most major hotels, the best transit links, and Kin Khao. Mission Bay/SoMa suits SoMa venues. The Financial District is convenient on weekdays. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods

Events were confirmed on their official pages in an earlier run and not re-read this run; only 5 events listed because tonight's was dropped and none were added. Road closures, restaurants, fares, bikes and SFO notes are carried from earlier briefs and were not re-read. Nobody was contacted and nothing was signed up for.

Free Inside Music Talk with Alicia Mastromonaco on stage one hour before each concert. Día de los Muertos altars in the lobby through Nov 11.
https://www.sfsymphony.org/Buy-Tickets/2026-27/Isabel-Leonard-Sings-Ravel

2) SF Opera: Strauss In Concert: Fri Nov 6, 7:30 pm. War Memorial Opera House, 301 Van Ness Ave. Music Director Eun Sun Kim leads the Opera Orchestra in Till Eulenspiegel, Strauss's Four Last Songs (soprano Kathleen O'Mara replacing Adela Zaharia), and a new Der Rosenkavalier suite arrangement in its U.S. debut. About 1 hour 33 minutes with one intermission; tickets from $30.
https://www.sfopera.com/seasons/fall-concert/

3) ZooLights opens: Fri Nov 6 – Sun Nov 8 (and ongoing). San Francisco Zoo, Sloat Blvd at the Great Highway. All-new holiday lights program through Jan 3, 2027 (Wed–Sun). https://www.sfzoo.org/zoolights/
